description: Lists dated transits to one person's birth chart: when the moving planets make exact aspects to the natal planets, and to the rising degree and Midheaven when the birth time and place are known, each with what astrology traditionally reads into it and a "Reading confidence NN%" label that says how specific the details were, not the odds of an event. By default it covers the next 30 days. In year-ahead mode it gives the year's highlights: the slow planets on the personal planets, the solar return, a Saturn return, Jupiter and Saturn changing sign, and eclipses near natal planets. It fits "my transits", "what is coming up for me" or "my year ahead", once a birth date has been given; get_horoscope and get_horoscope_period hold the Sun-sign horoscopes. A window is at most 366 days, and a window over 92 days keeps to Jupiter through Pluto. The window cannot start before the birth date. Without a birth time the Moon, the rising degree and the Midheaven are left out. Without currentZone dates use the birthplace's clock, or UTC if that is missing too, and the answer says which. Each line is astrology's reading, not a guarantee, and not health, financial or medical advice. It refuses a birth date less than 13 years ago, so it also refuses transits to a chart of today. For a birth date under 18 romantic and attraction readings are left out and a note says so.

birthDate.description: The birth date, such as 1994-05-14 (years 1800 to 2199).

currentZone.description: Where the person lives now, such as America/Mexico_City, so dates fall on their own clock. Without it, dates use the birthplace clock, or UTC if that is missing too, and the answer says which.

from.description: For window: the first day, such as 2026-11-01. Defaults to today.

latitude.description: Optional. The birthplace's latitude; with a birth time it adds the rising degree and Midheaven. Give it with longitude and zone. Nothing is stored.

longitude.description: Optional. The birthplace's longitude, with latitude. Nothing is stored.

mode.description: window (the default): every exact contact between from and to. year-ahead: the year from today, with Jupiter and Saturn, the solar return, a Saturn return, sign changes and eclipses near the chart.

time.description: The birth time on the local clock, only if the person knows it. Never guess it. Needs zone. Without it the Moon, rising degree and Midheaven are left out.

to.description: For window: the last day, at most 366 days after from. Defaults to a 30-day window, from included.

zone.description: The birthplace's time zone, such as Europe/Madrid. Needed with a time or a place.

name: get_personal_transits

note.const: Astrology’s reading of the sky meeting your birth chart, for reflection: not a guarantee, and not a forecast of health or money.
